import sys
from collections import deque

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    d = int(data[1])
    xs = []
    ys = []
    idx = 2
    for _ in range(n):
        xs.append(int(data[idx]))
        ys.append(int(data[idx + 1]))
        idx += 2
    d2 = d * d
    infected = [False] * n
    infected[0] = True
    queue = deque([0])
    while queue:
        u = queue.popleft()
        ux, uy = xs[u], ys[u]
        for v in range(n):
            if not infected[v]:
                dx = xs[v] - ux
                dy = ys[v] - uy
                if dx * dx + dy * dy <= d2:
                    infected[v] = True
                    queue.append(v)
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        out.append("Yes" if infected[i] else "No")
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")

main()

                    q.append(v)

    for i in range(n):
        out.append("Yes" if infected[i] else "No")
